project_identity.name: 0x12-web_stack_debugging_2
project_identity.scope: Debugging and securing web servers by running processes as non-root users, focusing on privilege de-escalation and security best practices.
project_identity.description: Covers privilege de-escalation, security, Nginx, user permissions, and process management.

technicalSkills: Understand the security risks of running services as root
Learn how to configure web servers to run under non-root users
Apply the principle of least privilege in server configurations
Debug permission and ownership issues in web server setups
Configure Nginx to run as a specific unprivileged user
Analyze and fix port binding issues for non-root processes
Use shell scripting to automate service reconfiguration
Optimize scripts for conciseness while maintaining functionality
Handle service conflicts through process management
Apply security best practices to web server deployments
